findings.claim: the caller template hard-coded folders docs and a docs/**-only paths filter, dropping .okf
the skill gave a false reason for pushing before handing over the workflow
the order of the exact caller list in test_default_callers was not stated

verdict.text: All three findings are fixed and the edits break nothing.
The caller template now relies on the openviking-sync action's own default folders, the push reason is true, and the test-order rule is stated.
Pass.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree gave stamp green `91e89a2049abaac0d9b7852d8bbb1abd24177bc9b74e9e267649763f7ce43176`.
pre_commit, cli_tests and rows r1, r2 and r3 pass.
f1: `.github/actions/openviking-sync/action.yml` defaults `folders` to `docs` and `.okf`.
The skill's new "folders" input states the same default (line 17).
The template drops `with: folders:`, filters on `docs/**` and `.okf/**` (line 155), and lines 179-181 say to set `folders` and match `paths` for other folders.
r3 still passes, since the openviking-sync step now has no `with` keys at all.
f2: lines 140-143 now say the pinned SHA must exist on GitHub and `main` there should match what was applied.
Both are true.
f3: lines 70-73 say to add the caller in key order.
`test_default_callers` compares `list(rendered["callers"].values())` against a list, and Terraform map iteration is sorted by key, so key order is the right rule.

Round-1 note: each step-4 block is now a single shell call that does `cd <checkout>/...`, `eval "$(uv run localstack env)"` and the terraform command, with `<checkout>` and `<scratchpad>` placeholders explained at lines 84-87.
The `init` hint for a fresh worktree sits in the same call.
No leftover `$SCRATCH`.
`Vault refused role <key>` at line 192 matches the error text in `.github/actions/lab-auth/action.yml:98`.
